evidence.quote: so that the observations were sensitive to a combination of both point source emission and extended emission
we focus on observations of the (3,3) line, as it is the brightest of these six transitions

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Option that the minispiral lies in front of Sgr A East and absorbs all its emission, with a partly filled aperture: judged unlikely because the minispiral fills most of the aperture at 6 cm

evidence.quote: the minispiral emission appears to take up the majority of this aperture

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Option that the minispiral is inside the Sgr A East shell: judged incompatible with the geometric constraints

evidence.quote: we find that this is incompatible with the geometric constraints discussed previously

limitations_admitted.value: Deconvolution does not conserve integrated flux, leading to underestimates of extended emission in the NH3 combination

evidence.quote: The deconvolution algorithms used throughout this procedure do not conserve integrated flux densities.

limitations_admitted.value: CO absorption cannot set how far in front the clouds are

evidence.quote: While our absorption measurements alone cannot determine how far in front the 20 and 50 km/s clouds lie

limitations_admitted.value: Exact line-of-sight distances remain hard to determine

evidence.quote: their exact distance along the line of sight still remains difficult to determine

referee_caveats_inferred: Main result (cloud placement) rests on kinematic and absorption arguments rather than a quantitative fit; no uncertainties on velocity gradients
CO absorption features are assigned to the clouds by linewidth and velocity alone, and the spectrum extraction is not described
90 cm aperture analysis uses an image of unstated origin and three hand-placed apertures, so the alternative synchrotron-background picture is weakly constrained
ALMA data play a supporting role; much of the ALMA processing (self-cal, masks, line-free channels) is unspecified

missing_for_reproduction: tclean parameters beyond robust, masks and image sizes
Continuum subtraction and line-free channels for CND mosaic cubes
Aperture and extraction recipe for the 12CO absorption spectrum
VLA and GBT NH3 data access and processing details (only referred to other papers)
Identity and location of the 90 cm image
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Roughly 100-500 GB of raw ALMA data across the two projects (11-pointing Band 3 and 68-pointing Band 6 mosaics with 12m+ACA+TP, plus eight sessions of the 2019 survey); estimate only
reproducibility.score_reason: ALMA project codes and observation properties are given, but key imaging and extraction settings are missing, the VLA/GBT data and 90 cm image are not tied to public products, and the main conclusions are largely qualitative kinematic and chemical arguments.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The paper does not state data are public, many processing settings are missing, and the headline results (3D placement of clouds) are qualitative rather than numeric.
